Update, October 2: Many readers are curious about the full vehicle compatibility list for the Twelve South Airfly Drive. Our friends at 9to5Toys just published that list — be sure to check it out!

Twelve South, a company known for its high-end Apple accessories, is significantly expanding its Airfly brand today. The company is launching the Airfly Drive, an adapter that can turn wired CarPlay into wireless CarPlay. It's available for order starting today at $39.99. Here's how it works.

According to Twelve South, the Airfly Drive is compatible with most vehicles that ship with wired CarPlay, covering over 75 car brands and model years spanning 2014 to the present. The Airfly Drive itself uses a USB-A connector, but Twelve South includes a USB-C adapter in the box. It features a small aluminum design that's meant to stay plugged in.

Twelve South's Airfly Drive requires no apps or accounts. You simply plug it into your car's USB port, pair your phone once, and you're done. After that, the Airfly Drive will automatically reconnect to your phone, delivering a wireless CarPlay experience. It also supports pairing two phones, allowing you to switch between them with the press of a button.

Here are some specs and features, as listed by Twelve South:

  • Use wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on your car's built-in display.
  • Plug and play — no apps, accounts, or charging required.
  • Fast automatic reconnect every time you start your car.
  • One-button switching between two paired phones.
  • Small aluminum housing designed to stay plugged in.
  • Supports both USB-A and USB-C, with a USB-A to USB-C adapter included in the box.
  • Works with your car's existing display, buttons, and steering wheel controls.
  • Ongoing compatibility updates.

Wireless CarPlay is significantly smoother than wired CarPlay, especially during short drives around town. For CarPlay users, it's a real quality-of-life improvement.

The Airfly Drive is available to order from Twelve South starting today for $39.99, in black or white. It also supports Android Auto.
